correctness.rationale: For every finite quiver allowing loops/multiple arrows, the unital generation condition splits into pairwise distinct k-coordinate vertex labels in F_q^k and surjectivity of independent arrow-corner maps T_uw restricted to the codimension-one annihilator of the label difference (full k-space for loops). The lifted diagonal idempotents and 1+J conjugation establish the criterion in both directions; conditional independent finite-field map ranks give the stated product P_{Q,q}(k). Positive factors yield d(A)=max(ceil(log_q v),max_u a_uu,max_{u ne w,a_uw>0}(a_uw+1)). In the simple loopless case logs with q^k/v^2->c and m/v^2->rho give exp[-(1/2+q*rho)/c]; outer regimes follow birthday bound and uniform log expansion. The v=1 no-arrow zero-generator special case is explicitly interpreted, while the formula is for k>=1. Independently enumerated generated subalgebras for 2 vertices/one arrow over F2 at k=1,2,3: counts 0,24,336 match formula, but finite checks are not the proof.
